WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           TRIM(s.GSserved) AS grade_span_served
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.School IS NOT NULL
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM satscores AS sat
          WHERE sat.cds = s.CDSCode
            AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
      )
), starting_grades AS (
    SELECT school_name,
           grade_span_served,
           CASE
               WHEN INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') = 0 THEN grade_span_served
               ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(grade_span_served, 1, INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') - 1))
           END AS start_grade
    FROM eligible
), ranked_grades AS (
    SELECT school_name,
           grade_span_served,
           CASE
               WHEN UPPER(start_grade) IN ('P', 'PK', 'PS', 'PRE', 'PRESCHOOL') THEN -2
               WHEN UPPER(start_grade) = 'TK' THEN -1
               WHEN UPPER(start_grade) = 'K' THEN 0
               ELSE CAST(start_grade AS INTEGER)
           END AS grade_order
    FROM starting_grades
)
SELECT school_name, grade_span_served
FROM ranked_grades
WHERE grade_order = (SELECT MIN(grade_order) FROM ranked_grades)
ORDER BY school_name COLLATE NOCASE;

WITH county_records AS (
    SELECT CDSCode AS cds_code,
           substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) AS district_code,
           District AS district_name,
           DOC,
           School,
           AdmFName1,
           AdmFName2,
           AdmFName3
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
),
public_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_code, district_name
    FROM county_records
    WHERE substr(cds_code, -7) = '0000000'
      AND DOC IN ('00', '52', '54', '56')
),
school_records AS (
    SELECT cds_code, district_code, AdmFName1, AdmFName2, AdmFName3
    FROM county_records
    WHERE substr(cds_code, -7) <> '0000000'
      AND NULLIF(trim(School), '') IS NOT NULL
),
school_admin_names AS (
    SELECT cds_code, district_code, NULLIF(trim(AdmFName1), '') AS first_name
    FROM school_records
    UNION
    SELECT cds_code, district_code, NULLIF(trim(AdmFName2), '')
    FROM school_records
    UNION
    SELECT cds_code, district_code, NULLIF(trim(AdmFName3), '')
    FROM school_records
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS total_schools
    FROM school_admin_names
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY total_schools DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT d.district_name,
       t.first_name,
       COUNT(a.cds_code) AS school_count
FROM public_districts AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS t
LEFT JOIN school_admin_names AS a
    ON a.district_code = d.district_code
   AND a.first_name = t.first_name
GROUP BY d.district_code, d.district_name, t.first_name, t.total_schools
ORDER BY d.district_name, d.district_code, t.total_schools DESC, t.first_name;

WITH eligible AS (

           f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
           f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
           1.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS frpm_share

    SELECT MAX(frpm_count) AS max_count, MIN(frpm_share) AS min_share
    FROM eligible
), selected AS (
    SELECT 1 AS part_order, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, e.*
    FROM eligible AS e CROSS JOIN extremes AS x
    WHERE e.frpm_count = x.max_count
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'smallest FRPM share', e.*
    FROM eligible AS e CROSS JOIN extremes AS x
    WHERE e.frpm_share = x.min_share
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'the CDS code from my notes', e.*
    FROM eligible AS e
    WHERE e.CDSCode = '04615150435602'
)

           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(c.number AS INTEGER) DESC) AS collector_rank

)

       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data AS f WHERE f.uuid = a.uuid) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM abzan_cards AS a
WHERE a.collector_rank = 1
ORDER BY a.name;

WITH customer_totals AS (

    FROM customers AS c

           MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_consumption END) AS lam,
           MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_consumption END) AS kam
    FROM ranked
    WHERE segment_rank = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(sme - lam, 2) AS sme_minus_lam,
       ROUND(lam - kam, 2) AS lam_minus_kam,
       ROUND(kam - sme, 2) AS kam_minus_sme
FROM lowest_totals;

WITH annual_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date >= '201201' AND y.Date < '201301' THEN y.Consumption END) AS total_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date >= '201301' AND y.Date < '201401' THEN y.Consumption END) AS total_2013
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201201' AND y.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
), increases AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           100.0 * (total_2013 - total_2012) / NULLIF(total_2012, 0) AS increase_pct
    FROM annual_totals
), extremes AS (
    SELECT MIN(increase_pct) AS lowest, MAX(increase_pct) AS highest
    FROM increases
)
SELECT i.Segment, ROUND(i.increase_pct, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM increases AS i
CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
WHERE i.increase_pct IN (e.lowest, e.highest)
ORDER BY i.increase_pct DESC, i.Segment;

           SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS away_wins
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_win_counts AS a
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = a.away_team_api_id
WHERE a.away_wins = (SELECT MAX(away_wins) FROM away_win_counts)
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;

WITH salary_bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS lowest_salary, MAX(A11) AS highest_salary
    FROM district
), eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    CROSS JOIN salary_bounds AS s
    WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 = s.lowest_salary
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.account_id,
       s.highest_salary - s.lowest_salary AS salary_difference
FROM eligible_clients AS c
JOIN disp AS p ON p.client_id = c.client_id
CROSS JOIN salary_bounds AS s
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM eligible_clients)
ORDER BY p.account_id;
```

    VALUES ('áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'ÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ', 'acdeeinorstuuyz')
),
central_names(district_name, inhabitants, crimes_1996, sort_name, n) AS (
    SELECT A2, CAST(A4 AS INTEGER), A16, lower(A2), 0
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT district_name, inhabitants, crimes_1996,
           replace(
               replace(sort_name, substr(lower_chars, n + 1, 1), substr(plain_chars, n + 1, 1)),
               substr(upper_chars, n + 1, 1), substr(plain_chars, n + 1, 1)
           ),
           n + 1
    FROM central_names CROSS JOIN accent_map
    WHERE n < length(plain_chars)
),
top_three AS (
    SELECT district_name, inhabitants, crimes_1996, sort_name
    FROM central_names CROSS JOIN accent_map
    WHERE n = length(plain_chars)
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, sort_name ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM top_three) AS top_three_avg,
           AVG(A16) AS overall_avg
    FROM district
)
SELECT district_name,
       crimes_1996,
       ROUND(top_three_avg, 2) AS top_three_avg_1996,
       ROUND(overall_avg, 2) AS overall_avg_1996,
       ROUND(top_three_avg - overall_avg, 2) AS difference_1996
FROM top_three CROSS JOIN averages
ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, sort_name ASC;

WITH opened_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 IN (SELECT A3 FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice')
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
), ranked_balances AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, a.district_name, t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.account_id
               ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM opened_accounts AS a
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
), year_end_balances AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name, balance
    FROM ranked_balances
    WHERE rn = 1
), district_stats AS (
    SELECT district_name, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_1996,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM year_end_balances
    GROUP BY district_id, district_name
)
SELECT district_name, accounts_opened_1996,
       ROUND(avg_balance, 2) AS district_avg_end_of_1996_balance,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) FROM year_end_balances)
           AS region_avg_end_of_1996_balance,
       (SELECT district_name
        FROM district_stats
        WHERE avg_balance IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC
        LIMIT 1) AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY district_name ASC;

WITH withdrawals_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_orders_by_account AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_debit
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
standing_order_average_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           AVG(COALESCE(s.total_debit, 0.0)) AS average_debit_per_account
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN standing_orders_by_account AS s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A3 AS region,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
           w.total_withdrawn,
           1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
           s.average_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawals_by_district AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN standing_order_average_by_district AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
       ROUND(average_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, district_name;

           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) AS population_rank,

    FROM district_populations AS d

    ch.card_type,
    ch.age_at_issue,
    COALESCE(al.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(al.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN al.loan_count > 0 AND ch.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'

WITH ranked_loans AS (

    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
), selected_loans AS (

), account_activity AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM selected_loans)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
), regional_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS region_loan_count
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), regional_salaries AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS region_average_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3

SELECT s.client_id,
       ROUND(s.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
       s.duration AS duration_months,
       ROUND(s.payments * s.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
       ROUND(s.payments * s.duration - s.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
       s.status AS loan_status,
       d.A2 AS branch_district,
       d.A3 AS branch_region,
       COALESCE(aa.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,

           WHEN COALESCE(aa.total_deposits, 0) > s.amount THEN 'Medium Income'

JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

           MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM branch_accounts AS a

WITH italian_constructors AS (

    FROM constructors
    WHERE nationality = 'Italian'
), season_standings AS (
    SELECT cs.constructorId,
           cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
               ORDER BY r.round DESC, r.raceId DESC

    FROM constructorStandings AS cs

    JOIN italian_constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId

           c.name,
           c.url,
           COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0.0) AS career_points
    FROM italian_constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_standings AS s
        ON s.constructorId = c.constructorId AND s.season_row = 1
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
), ranked AS (
    SELECT name,
           career_points,
           url,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM career_totals
)
SELECT name AS constructor_name,
       career_points,
       url AS introduction_website
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_rank, constructor_name;

WITH local_starts AS (
    SELECT c.circuitRef,
           time(r.time, printf('%+d minutes', CASE
               -- These archive entries already use venue-local time.
               WHEN r.year <= 2006
                 OR (c.circuitRef = 'yas_marina' AND r.date = '2017-11-26') THEN 0
               -- UTC offsets on the recorded race dates.
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'americas' THEN
                   CASE WHEN r.date < date(r.year || '-11-01', 'weekday 0')
                        THEN -300 ELSE -360 END
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'rodriguez' THEN -360
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('indianapolis', 'villeneuve') THEN -240
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'interlagos' THEN -120
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'silverstone' THEN 60
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('bahrain', 'istanbul') THEN 180
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('BAK', 'yas_marina') THEN 240
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'sochi' THEN CASE WHEN r.year = 2014 THEN 240 ELSE 180 END
               WHEN c.circuitRef = 'buddh' THEN 330
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('marina_bay', 'sepang', 'shanghai') THEN 480
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('fuji', 'suzuka', 'yeongam') THEN 540
               WHEN c.circuitRef IN ('catalunya', 'hockenheimring', 'hungaroring',
                                     'magny_cours', 'monaco', 'monza', 'nurburgring',
                                     'red_bull_ring', 'spa', 'valencia') THEN 120
           END)) AS local_start
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
), extrema AS (
    SELECT MIN(local_start) AS earliest, MAX(local_start) AS latest
    FROM local_starts
)
SELECT (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef FROM local_starts
              WHERE local_start = e.earliest ORDER BY circuitRef)) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
       (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef FROM local_starts
              WHERE local_start = e.latest ORDER BY circuitRef)) AS latest_circuit_refs,
       CAST(strftime('%s', e.latest) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%s', e.earliest) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
FROM extrema AS e;

    SELECT link_to_member AS member_id, expense_description, cost
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'

),

    JOIN spending AS s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_parts (ID, diagnosis, remaining) AS (
    SELECT ID, NULL,
           CASE
               WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Diagnosis)) IN ('RA  SJS', 'SJS  RA') THEN 'RA,SJS'
               ELSE REPLACE(UPPER(Diagnosis), CHAR(29), ',')
           END || ','
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ID,
           TRIM(SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, ',') - 1), ' ' || CHAR(9, 10, 11, 13)),
           SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM diagnosis_parts
    WHERE remaining <> ''
), overlap_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM diagnosis_parts
    WHERE diagnosis <> ''
      AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '% SUSP'
      AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '% SUSP.'
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT diagnosis) = 2
       AND MAX(diagnosis = 'RA') = 1
       AND MAX(diagnosis = 'SJS') = 1
), platelet_history AS (
    SELECT p.ID, EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.PLT > 100
          AND l.PLT < 400
    ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM overlap_patients AS p

WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_parts (ID, diagnosis, remaining) AS (
    SELECT ID, NULL,
           CASE
               WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Diagnosis)) IN ('RA  SJS', 'SJS  RA') THEN 'RA,SJS'
               ELSE REPLACE(UPPER(Diagnosis), CHAR(29), ',')
           END || ','
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ID,
           TRIM(SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, ',') - 1), ' ' || CHAR(9, 10, 11, 13)),
           SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM diagnosis_parts
    WHERE remaining <> ''
), overlap_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM diagnosis_parts
    WHERE diagnosis <> ''
      AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '% SUSP'
      AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '% SUSP.'
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT diagnosis) = 2
       AND MAX(diagnosis = 'RA') = 1
       AND MAX(diagnosis = 'SJS') = 1
), platelet_history AS (
    SELECT p.ID, EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.PLT > 100
          AND l.PLT < 400
    ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM overlap_patients AS p
)
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 END) AS ever_normal_platelet,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 END) AS never_normal_platelet
FROM platelet_history;

WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_parts(ID, SEX, diagnosis, remaining) AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, '',
           REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(p.Diagnosis), CHAR(29), ','), '  ', ',') || ','
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ID, SEX,
           TRIM(SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, ',') - 1)),
           SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM diagnosis_parts
    WHERE remaining <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT ID, SEX
FROM diagnosis_parts
WHERE diagnosis IN ('SLE', 'SLE (DIFFUSE LE)')
ORDER BY SEX, ID;

WITH protein_results AS (
    SELECT ID, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
), protein_amounts AS (
    SELECT ID,
           TRIM(CASE
               WHEN result GLOB '>=*' THEN SUBSTR(result, 3)
               WHEN result GLOB '+[0-9](*)' THEN SUBSTR(result, 4, LENGTH(result) - 4)
               ELSE result
           END) AS amount
    FROM protein_results
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM protein_amounts AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND u.amount GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.amount AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;
